system: System layer: Shippin-wide defaults. The top of the chain; every customer starts here.
plan: Plan layer: what a tier (Free, Pro, Team, Enterprise) changes on top of system defaults.
tenant: Tenant layer: one customer's own overrides, allowed only where the layers above permit.
workspace: Workspace layer: a single devspace's override (narrowest scope).
locked: Locked: children cannot change this value. Attempts are shown as rejected.
overridable: Overridable: a child layer replaces the value outright.
mergeable: Mergeable: lists combine. Children add entries; a parent deny (!entry) can't be removed.
bounded: Bounded: children may change the value only within min/max (or an allowed set). Out-of-range values are clamped and flagged.
provision_intent: Provision intent: a recorded desired state. It stays pending until an operator applies it; nothing is created from this screen.
effective: Effective config: the value a customer actually gets after merging every layer.
draft: Draft: created here, not yet linked to a sign-in org or provisioned.
matrix: Service matrix: which services each tier includes and the limits it grants.
